name: rpstills portrait natural v1
space: DaVinci Wide Gamut / DaVinci Intermediate in and out; the timeline's output colour space is sRGB, so the look has no output transform
source_policy: Fitted and applied on RAW decodes only (paid deliverables are RAW).

fit.note: Session median skin, CIELAB. The targets are defaults for natural, slightly warm portrait skin and are the decision to revisit on a hero frame: raise b* for warmer, L* for brighter.
fit.measured_on: 49 solo portraits, one overcast outdoor session, neutral RAW decode

per_shot_trim.rule: look.trim_ev(frame skin L*, session median skin L*), measured on the neutral render: half the exposure error, limit 0.6 EV, step 0.2 EV. One LUT variant per distinct trim, params.exposure_ev plus the trim.

known_limits: Pale overcast skies go to clean white (up to 40% of the frame near white on the brightest backgrounds). Lower shoulder_knee or exposure_ev for sky tone.
One session-wide white balance warms every face by the same amount. Hue spread between people is preserved, but a naturally warm face can read warm; check the warmest by hue.
Fitted for one lighting condition. Refit with the same procedure for a new session; do not reuse the numbers.
